verdict.rationale: Framer explicitly states it does not use or require MCP: 'Framer doesn't require a separate MCP server... without manual MCP setup' (framer-docs-34). Its actual capability runs in the opposite direction — external agents like Claude Code/Cursor connect INTO Framer to use Framer's canvas/CMS as their tool, not Framer consuming external MCP servers' tools. No evidence exists of Framer acting as an MCP client that plugs in third-party MCP servers.
